thread:
ci-bot: [ALERT] perf-ci/usw2-l4 p99 latency increased ~3.8x on merge build #4521 - job: latency-regression-a10. Dashboard: https://ci.internal/reports/4521 :warning:

sam: anyone oncall? this is the canary region for L4/A10 runs

liu: i'm on it. quick glance — the failing run coincides with merge M-4123 (scheduler: tighten podAffinity).

priya: M-4123? that was the change to make worker pods prefer same-az affinity for cache-locality, right? thought it only adjusted preferred->required for a subset.

liu: correct — a subset of statefulsets switched to requiredDuringScheduling to reduce cross-az KV hops. but cluster-autoscaler ended up packing pods onto fewer hosts in usw2-a.

marco: seeing huge packet drops on a couple of nodes in usw2-a. `ethtool -S eth0` shows high tx_errors on host-10-3-7. also NIC transmit queue depth spikes.

anna: KV cache eviction graphs from the canary run: `kv_cache.evictions/s` jumped 6x right around deploy. prefix cache hit% dropped from 92 -> 73. i think eviction churn is causing more memcopies per request. :thinking: 

priya: that would explain higher p99 — more KV misses => longer generation (rehydrate KV + kernel switch). any kernel_selector logs?

liu: grabbed logs. kernel_selector fell back to `matmul_fallback` more often because sequence length distribution changed when batching collapsed. snippet:

```
// kernel_selector: chosen=optimized_gemm, fallback=matmul_fallback, reason="batch_size=1"
// trace: request_group_size=1, avg_tokens=24, kv_hit=false
```

sam: batching collapsed to size=1? why did batching drop?

marco: because requests got spread to fewer GPUs with higher per-host contention; batching heuristic uses per-GPU queue depth and some rate smoothing — if queue latency spikes, it flushes early. packing and NIC backpressure caused flushes.

anna: i captured a small run with tcpdump + perf. tcp retransmits up ~12%, and the runtime profiler shows a 2.6x increase in time spent in `kv_cache::load_or_miss` and a notable increase in memcpy in `cudaMemcpyAsync` (host->device).

priya: sounds like network-induced KV misses + smaller batches => worse kernels + more memcopies. combined multiplicative effect on p99.

ops-bot: infra note: node host-10-3-7 currently shows: cpu_steal=4.8%, ifconfig eth0 tx_errors=412, rx_errors=0, interface util ~78% of 100GbE.

liu: i'm running a bisect locally across merges between 4490..4521. early result: reverting M-4123 in canary rollback drops p99 back close to baseline. rolling revert in progress on canary.

sam: great. can we also get a deterministic repro for upstream CI so CI doesn't flake?

anna: repro steps i used (short):
```
# run against canary gateway in usw2-l4
for i in {1..200}; do \n  curl -sS -H "X-Region:usw2-l4" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n    -d '{"prompt":"tokenize me"}' https://gateway.internal/v1/llm/generate &\n  sleep 0.02
done
```

marco: and `kubectl get pods -o wide -n inference --selector=role=worker` on canary shows pods concentrated on 3 hosts (out of 16), which is abnormal. output snippet:
```
NAME                 READY STATUS  NODE           IP
worker-0             1/1   Running host-10-3-7   10.3.7.45
worker-1             1/1   Running host-10-3-7   10.3.7.46
worker-2             1/1   Running host-10-3-9   10.3.9.22
```

priya: so required affinity forced grouping on few hosts -> NIC + CPU contention -> batching collapse -> kernel fallback + KV misses -> p99 regression. rough causal chain.

sam: can we mitigate short-term without reverting the scheduler change? maybe tune batching windows or increase batching timeout for A10 profiles?

liu: possible. quick patch: raise max_batch_delay for A10/L4 profiles from 6ms -> 12ms to allow queueing despite transient latency. i can test in canary after rollback completes (to isolate behavior).

marco: also worth adding a guard in autoscaler/pod-scheduler: respect spreadAcrossHosts for latency-sensitive pools. the affinity change was too strict for inference-worker pool.

anna: filed ENG-1189 with profiling artifacts + flamegraphs + pcap. attaching: https://artifacts.internal/ENG-1189/ (pcap, flame, ethtool dumps)

ops-bot: Revert MR M-4123 deployed to canary (rollback id: rb-4523). Monitoring p99...

sam: thanks. action items:
- liu: validate rollback restores baseline and run perf CI rerun (priority)
- priya: prepare short term batching config change if rollback insufficient
- marco/ops: investigate NIC scheduling and host telemetry to avoid recurrence
- anna: add KV cache instrumentation for eviction root-cause (which keys, prefixes)

priya: i'll also put a temporary CI gate: if usw2-l4 p99 > 2x baseline, block merge until investigation.

sam: ping me with updates. :thumbsup:
